title: Implementing Kernel PCA for Non-Linear Data: Step-by-Step Guide

cues.en: -: Hello, and welcome to this art tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So now we know how to implement two feature extraction techniques.
cues.zh: 現在已經知道如何實作兩種特徵擷取技術。

cues.en: These are PCA and LDA, but these feature extraction techniques work on linear problems.
cues.zh: 也就是 PCA 與 LDA，但這些技術適合線性問題，

cues.en: That is when the data is linearly separable.
cues.zh: 也就是資料可線性分隔的情況。

cues.en: And in this section we're gonna see one new feature extraction technique but this time adapted for non-linear problems where the data is non-linearly separable.
cues.zh: 這一節會看新的特徵擷取技術，適用於非線性問題，也就是資料不能線性分隔時。

cues.en: So this technique is called Kernel PCA.
cues.zh: 這項技術叫做核 PCA。

cues.en: Kernel PCA is a kernelized version of PCA where we map the data to a higher dimension using the kernel trick and then from there we extract some new principle components
cues.zh: 核 PCA 是 PCA 的核函數版本，透過核技巧，將資料映射到更高維，再從那裡擷取新的主成分，

cues.en: and we are gonna see how it manages to deal with non-linear problems.
cues.zh: 我們會看看它如何處理非線性問題。

cues.en: So we're not going to work on the same problem as we did in the previous sections, with the wine dataset but we're gonna work on the same dataset as the one used in part three classification
cues.zh: 所以不再使用前幾節的葡萄酒資料集，而是使用第三部分分類時的同一份資料集，

cues.en: because now we need visuals.
cues.zh: 因為現在需要視覺化。

cues.en: We need to clearly see what happens, we need to see how Kernel PCA manages to extract some new independent variables, the principal components, even when the problem is nonlinear,
cues.zh: 需要清楚看到發生什麼，看看即使問題是非線性的，核 PCA 如何擷取新自變數，也就是主成分，

cues.en: that is when the data is not linearly separable.
cues.zh: 換句話說，資料無法線性分隔時會怎樣。

cues.en: And this data set that we used in part three, the social network ads* dataset, well, remember it was clearly a nonlinear problem because nonlinear classifiers
cues.zh: 第三部分使用的 Social_Network_Ads 資料集，記得它明顯是非線性問題，因為非線性分類器

cues.en: showed much better performance.
cues.zh: 表現好得多。

cues.en: So let's take this data set and let's supply Kernel PCA to see how it'll handle the nonlinearity.
cues.zh: 使用這份資料，套用核 PCA，看看如何處理非線性。

cues.en: So let's find this data set into our working directory folder.
cues.zh: 到工作目錄找到資料集。

cues.en: So we'll go to our machine a set folder, then part nine, dimensionality reduction.
cues.zh: 進入 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾，再進入 Part 9 Dimensionality Reduction。

cues.en: And here we are at the last section of this part nine Kernel PCA.
cues.zh: 這是第九部分最後一節，Kernel PCA。

cues.en: So that's the folder you wanna set as a working directory.
cues.zh: 這就是要設為工作目錄的資料夾。

cues.en: Make sure that you have the social network at CSV file.
cues.zh: 確認有 Social_Network_Ads.csv。

cues.en: And if that's the case you're ready to click on this more button here to set the folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 有的話，按 More，將資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: And now what we're gonna do is take this logistic regression model because you know this logistic regression model is a linear classifier, therefore it will not be appropriate
cues.zh: 現在取用邏輯斯迴歸模型，因為它是線性分類器，所以不太適合

cues.en: for our problem because our data is not linearly separable.
cues.zh: 目前這個資料無法線性分隔的問題。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do is take this linear classifier here but we are going to apply Kernel PCA inside of it to see how Kernel PCA will save the situation.
cues.zh: 我們會保留這個線性分類器，但在前面套用核 PCA，看看它如何改善情況。

cues.en: And so you will see that even if we apply a linear model, well thanks to Kernel PCA, that will manage to extract new principle components adapted for this non-linearly separable data.
cues.zh: 因此即使用線性模型，核 PCA 仍能擷取適合這些非線性可分資料的新主成分。

cues.en: Well, you will see that will get amazing results.
cues.zh: 你會看到結果非常好。

cues.en: So right now, let's copy the whole model here from the top down to the bottom, copy, and let's paste it in our AL PCA file.
cues.zh: 現在將整個模型程式從上選到底，複製，再貼到核 PCA 檔案。

cues.en: All right, and now basically the only thing that we have to do is to apply AL PCA at the right place.
cues.zh: 基本上唯一要做的，就是在正確位置套用核 PCA。

cues.en: But before we do that, I would just like us to visualize again why this linear model is not appropriate for this data set.
cues.zh: 不過之前，先再次視覺化，看看為什麼這個線性模型不適合資料集。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do is take everything from here because you know this will visualize the training set results by plotting the prediction regions and the prediction boundary.
cues.zh: 取用這裡的全部內容，因為這會畫出預測區域與決策邊界，視覺化訓練集結果。

cues.en: So we're gonna take everything from here up to the top to, you know import the data set, apply the pre-processing phase, fit the logistic regression to the training set,
cues.zh: 從這裡一路選到最上方，匯入資料集、前處理，再將邏輯斯迴歸擬合到訓練集，

cues.en: and eventually plot the training set results.
cues.zh: 最後畫出訓練集結果。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: Let's visualize this again very quickly and that will give us motivation to apply Kernel PCA.
cues.zh: 快速再看一次，這會讓我們更有動力套用核 PCA。

cues.en: And here we go, all executed properly.
cues.zh: 好了，全部正確執行。

cues.en: So as a reminder, the points are the real observations that is, are real customers in the social network represented by their age and their estimated salary.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，點是實際觀測資料，也就是社群網路的真實顧客，以年齡與預估薪資表示。

cues.en: So that's our real observation points.
cues.zh: 這些就是實際觀測資料點。

cues.en: And our predictions are represented by these regions, the red region here and the green region here, and basically this red region is where our model predicts
cues.zh: 預測則由紅色、綠色區域表示，基本上紅色區域，是模型預測

cues.en: that the customer will not click on the ad.
cues.zh: 顧客不會點廣告的地方。

cues.en: And this green region here is the region where our model predicts that the customers will click on the ad and buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 綠色區域，是模型預測顧客會點廣告並購買 SUV 的地方。

cues.en: And so remember the problem was that this straight line here is actually the prediction boundary generated by the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 記得問題在於，這條直線是邏輯斯迴歸產生的決策邊界。

cues.en: But since the logistic regression model is a linear classifier, then it has to be a straight line here separating the data.
cues.zh: 但因為邏輯斯迴歸是線性分類器，所以必須以直線區分資料。

cues.en: And therefore, remember the problem is that it cannot make some kind of a curve here to catch these green users that should be in the green region. Right now they're in the red region,
cues.zh: 問題是，它不能在這裡彎曲，把應該在綠色區域的綠色顧客點包進去。目前它們在紅色區域，

cues.en: and so this clearly represents the fact that our data is not linearly separable because we can clearly see that this prediction boundary here, that plays the role of separator, and that
cues.zh: 所以清楚顯示資料無法線性分隔，因為這條扮演分隔線的決策邊界，

cues.en: is supposed to separate the two classes.
cues.zh: 應該要分開兩個類別，

cues.en: Well, it cannot separate the two classes properly because as you can see, these users are not in the right region.
cues.zh: 卻無法妥善區分，如你所見，這些使用者不在正確區域。

cues.en: And so now what we're gonna do is not make a nonlinear classifier like we did in part three.
cues.zh: 接下來不會像第三部分那樣，建立非線性分類器，

cues.en: You know, when we made Kernel SVM nice based decision trees or random forests.
cues.zh: 例如核 SVM、樸素貝氏、決策樹或隨機森林。

cues.en: Well, what we're gonna do now instead, is apply Kernel PCA so that we keep a straight line as a separator, as the prediction boundary of a linear classifier.
cues.zh: 取而代之，會套用核 PCA，仍保留直線，作為線性分類器的決策邊界。

cues.en: That is still going to be the prediction boundary of a logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 也就是仍然使用邏輯斯迴歸的決策邊界。

cues.en: But since we're going to apply Kernel PCA, well, this will manage to apply some trick; where the trick is actually the kernel trick to map the data into higher
cues.zh: 但套用核 PCA 後，會使用一個技巧，也就是核技巧，將資料映射到更高

cues.en: dimension and then apply PCA to extract new components that will be new dimensions that explain the most variants.
cues.zh: 維，再套用 PCA，擷取最能解釋變異的新成分，也就是新維度。

cues.en: But thanks to this kernel trick, well you'll see that we'll manage to get some new dimensions in which the data will be literally separable even by linear classifiers
cues.zh: 透過核技巧，你會看到能取得新的維度，在那裡資料可以線性分隔，即使用線性分類器，

cues.en: like logistic regression.
cues.zh: 例如邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: So as for PCA and LDA, we're gonna start by creating an object, which will be the Kernel PCA object as we will use to transform our original data set
cues.zh: 和 PCA、LDA 一樣，先建立物件，也就是核 PCA 物件，用來將原始資料集

cues.zh: 透過核技巧，轉換為新的資料集。

cues.en: So we'll call the subject K PCA and then equals, and then that's where we use the function that will create this Kernel PCA object.
cues.zh: 將物件命名為 kpca，等於，再使用建立核 PCA 物件的函式。

cues.zh: 這裡教你一個簡單有效率地描述模型的小技巧。

cues.en: We can simply input here at tilde and dot and that will be enough for the K PCA function to understand what the formula is.
cues.zh: 只需輸入波浪號與點，就足以讓 kpca 理解公式。

cues.zh: 因為接著會加入第二個參數 data。

cues.en: And that is actually the training set but without the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 就是訓練集，但不包含依變數。

cues.en: Because remember, Kernel PCA is just a PCA technique where we use the kernel trick to map the data into a higher dimension and then apply PCA because indeed,
cues.zh: 記得核 PCA 只是使用核技巧，將資料映射到高維，再套用 PCA，因為講者表示，

cues.en: in this higher dimension, the data is linearly acceptable.
cues.zh: 在這個高維空間中，資料就能線性分隔。

cues.en: And therefore, since we applied PCA in this higher dimension and PCA is an unsupervised technique, well here for the data argument, we just need to input the training set, but without the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 在高維空間套用 PCA，而 PCA 是非監督式技術，所以 data 只需訓練集，不含依變數。

cues.en: And therefore, as for PCA, we input here data equals training set, then bracket to remove the dependent variable,
cues.zh: 因此和 PCA 一樣，輸入 data = training_set，再用中括號移除依變數，

cues.zh: 它的索引是 3，因為只有兩個自變數。

cues.zh: 好。

cues.zh: 下一個參數是 kernel。

cues.zh: 就是 features，代表最後希望有幾個特徵、幾個主成分。

cues.zh: 這裡當然希望在二維空間視覺化訓練集與測試集結果。
